shortDescription: Manage S3 Keys on a PowerScale Storage System

options.name: access_zone
options.description: Specifies the access zone in which the S3 bucket exists. Access zone once set cannot be changed.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: existing_key_expiry_minutes
options.description: Duration in minutes for which old key should remain valid.

options.name: generate_new_key
options.description: Whether a new S3 key should be generated. Value C(if_not_present) indicates that a new S3 key is only generated if there is no existing key. Value C(always) indicates that a new S3 key is always generated, even if there is an existing key.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the S3 key should exist or not. Value C(present) indicates that the S3 key should exist in system. Value C(absent) indicates that the S3 key should not exist in system.

options.name: user
options.description: Specifies the user that owns the S3 key. If users belongs to another provider domain, it should be mentioned along with domain name as "DOMAIN_NAME\\username" or DOMAIN_NAME\username.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
